questions.question: A batsman makes a score of 81 runs in the 16th match and thus increases his average runs per match by 3. What is his average after the 16th match?
questions.solution:
Let the average before 16th match be y.

According to the problem statement

Average before 16th match can be given

⇒ sum of runs made till 15th match/15 = y

⇒ sum of runs made till 15th match = 15y ----(i)

Now,

⇒ y + 3 = (sum of runs made till 15th match + 81)/16, Using (i)

⇒ 16y + 48 = 15y + 81

⇒ y = 33

∴ The average after 16th match is 36 ⇒ (33 + 3)

questions.question: What is the value of √2 Sec 45° + (1/√3)Tan 30°?
questions.solution:
Since we know that sec 45 = √2 and tan 30 = 1/√3 , put this in the required equation

⇒ √2 Sec 45° + (1/√3)Tan 30°

⇒ √2 × √2 + (1/√3) × (1/√3) = 2 + 1/3 = 7/3

∴ The value of√2 Sec 45° + (1/√3)Tan 30° is 7/3

questions.question: If Cos θ = 15/17, then what is the value of Cosec θ?
questions.solution:
Sin θ can be given as

⇒ Sin θ = √(1 - cos² θ) = √(1 - 15²/17²) = √{(289 - 225)/17²} = √(8²/17²) = 8/17

And we know that Cosec θ = 1/sin θ = 1/(8/17) = 17/8

∴ Cosec θ is 17/8

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks up his wares by 60% and offers 10% discount. What will be the selling price (in Rs.) if the cost price is Rs. 7500?
questions.solution:
Marked price can be given as 60% more of cost price

Marked price = 7500 × (1 + 60/100) = 1.6 × 7500 = 12000

After giving 10% discount on this price

After discount = 12000 × (1 - 10/100) = 0.9 × 12000 = 10800

∴ The selling price be Rs. 10800

questions.question: If ax - 4y = -6 has a slope of -3/2. What is the value of a?
questions.solution:
Slope of this straight line can be given as

⇒ (-a)/(-4) = -3/2

⇒ a = -6

∴ The value of a is -6

questions.question: What are the coordinates of the reflection of the point (-3, 1) about the line x = -2?
questions.solution:
Solving for the reflection of the point (-3, 1) about x = -2,

Since we know that the Y co-ordinate will not change and the X coordinate can be given as, 

X co-ordinates + 2 × (X coordinates of the line - Given X coordinates)

⇒ -3 + 2 × (-2 - (-3)) = -1

∴ The coordinates of the reflection are (-1, 1).

questions.question: A and B together do a job in 15 days and A alone could do the same job in 20 days. How many days would B take to do half the job if he worked alone?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day can be given as 1/20th of the total work

Let the work done by B in 1 day be 1/y of the total work

From the problem statement

⇒ 1/20 + 1/y = 1/15

⇒ 1/y = 1/15 - 1/20 = 1/60

⇒ y = 60

Time required by B to complete the work is 60 days

Time required to complete the half work is ½ × 60 = 30 days

∴ The time required to complete half of the work is 30 days

questions.question: A man travelled a distance of 99 km in 9 hours. He travelled partly on foot @ 9 km/hr and partly on bicycle @ 18 km/hr. What is distance (in kms) travelled on foot?
questions.solution:
Let the time for which he had travelled with foot be t hrs. and then he travelled 9 - t hrs on bicycle

According to the problem statement

⇒ 9t + 18 × (9 - t) = 99

⇒ 9t + 162 - 18t = 99

⇒ t = 7 hours

∴ Distance travelled on foot = 7 × 9 = 63 Kms

questions.question: What is the sum of the first 17 terms of an arithmetic progression if the first term is - 20 and last term is 28?
questions.solution:
Sum cam be given as

⇒ Sum = number of terms × {(First term + last term)/2}

⇒ Sum = 17 × (- 20 + 28)/2 = 17 × 4 = 68

∴ The sum of first 17 terms is 68.

questions.question: A fraction is greater than twice its reciprocal by 7/15. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y - 2/y = 7/15

⇒ 15y² - 7y - 30 = 0

⇒ (y - 5/3)(y + 6/5) = 0

⇒ y = 5/3 or y = - 6/5

Only 5/3 satisfies the required condition given in the question

∴ The fraction is 5/3

questions.question: Two labourers A and B are paid a total of Rs. 1120 per day. If A is paid 180 percent of what is paid to B, how much (in Rs) is B paid?
questions.solution:
Let A will get Rs. a and B will get Rs. B

According to the problem statement

a + b = 1120 ----(i)

And a = 180b/100 = 1.8b ----(ii), Put this in (i)

⇒ 1.8b + b = 1120

⇒ 2.8b = 1120

⇒ b = 400

∴ The B will get Rs. 400

questions.question: Country E produced how many more cars (in %) than country B?
questions.solution:
Car produced by E = 0.9

Car produced by B = 0.8

Difference between them = 0.9 - 0.8 = 0.1

Percentage = 0.1 × 100/0.8 = 12.5%

∴ Country E produced 12.5% more cars than country B.

questions.question: If 35% of the cars produced by these six countries are diesel and the rest are petrol, then how many petrol cars were produced (in millions)?
questions.solution:
Given that 35% of total cars are diesel cars

Petrol cars are 100 - 35 = 65%

Total cars are = 0.4 + 0.8 + 0.3 + 0.1 + 0.9 + 0.2 = 2.7 million

Petrol cars = 65 × 2.7/100 = 1.755 million

∴ The petrol cars are 1.755 million

questions.question: If on an average the cost price of a car is 30000 USD and environmental tax levied on each car is 2.5% of its cost price, how much environmental tax was collected (in billion USD) from production of cars in these 6 countries?
questions.solution:
Environmental tax is 2.5% of 30000

Environmental tax = 2.5 × 30000/100 = 750 USD for 1 car sold

Total number of cars are = 0.4 + 0.8 + 0.3 + 0.1 + 0.9 + 0.2 = 2.7 million

Total environmental tax = 750 × 2.7 million = 2.03 billion USD

∴ The total environmental tax to be collected is 2.03 billion USD

questions.question: D and E are points on side AB and AC of ∆ABC. DE is parallel to BC. If AD : DB = 1 : 2 and area of ∆ABC is 45 sq cm, what is the area (in sq. cm) of quadrilateral BDEC?
questions.solution:
Given AD/DB = ½

DB/AD = 2/1, add 1 to both sides

⇒ (DB/AD) + 1 = (2/1) + 1

⇒ (DB + AD)/AD = 3/1

⇒ AB/AD = 3/1

⇒ AD/AB = 1/3

For triangle ADE and ABC areas are in the same ratio as that of square of ratios of sides

⇒ area of triangle ADE/area of triangle ABC = (AD/AB)² = 1/3² = 1/9

⇒ area of triangle ADE = 45 × 1/9 = 5 cm²

Area of quadrilateral can be given as area of triangle ABC - area of triangle ADE

⇒ Area of quadrilateral = 45 - 5 = 40 cm²

questions.question: A vendor buys 12 bananas for Rs. 60 and sells 5 bananas for Rs. 32. What will be his gain (in %)?
questions.solution:
He brought 1 banana for = 60/12 = Rs. 5

He sells 1 banana for = 32/5 = Rs. 6.4

Gain = 6.4 - 5 = Rs. 1.4

Gain percentage can be given as = gain × 100/5 = 1.4 × 100/5 = 28%

∴ The gain percentage will be 28%.

questions.question: The co-ordinates of the centroid of a triangle ABC are (2, 2). What are the co-ordinates of vertex C if co-ordinates of A and B are (7, -1) and (1, 2) respectively?
questions.solution:
Let the coordinate of C be (x, y)

Centroid of triangle can be given as

For X coordinate,

⇒ 2 = (x + 7 + 1)/3

⇒ x = -2

For Y coordinate,

⇒ 2 = (y - 1 + 2)/3

⇒ y = 5

∴ The coordinate of C is (-2, 5)

questions.question: If a³ - b³ = 91 and a - b = 1, then what is the value of ab?
questions.solution:
Given a - b = 1, cubing both sides

⇒ (a - b)³ = 1

⇒ a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b) = 1, using a³ - b³ = 91

⇒ 3ab = 90

⇒ ab = 30

∴ The value of ab is 30

questions.question: The compound interest earned in two years at 15% per annum is Rs. 20640. What is the sum invested (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Let the sum invested be Rs. P

Compound interest for 2 years at the rate of 15% per annum can be given as

⇒ CI = P{(1 + 15/100)² - 1}

⇒ 20640 = P(1.3225 - 1)

⇒ P = 20640/0.3225

⇒ P = 64000

∴ The sum invested is Rs. 64000
